items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: I met, I met, I met Manuel Sells playing with Sidney Desmond.

ctx.x: Yeah, but I was a Christian after, in 1935 at the Holy Ghost. Oh, did you know sales up the country? In Donalvilleville? No, no, I met, I met, I met Manuel Sells playing with Sidney Desmond. Manuel Sells at this time was living up here. Yeah. He always did live up here.
Uptown? Uptown. Yeah. He told me his family's from Donalvilleville. His sister, that's what he told me too.
